event.description: Share the tied FF hidden-unit vector across blocks
event.proposal: family: parameter tying; current retained incumbent is 2844 parameters at 100.0000%, a +1.00 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0058, tying one hidden unit input/output within each block at 2856/100.00%; same-family failed result: attempt-0059, tying two hidden units within each block at 2828/30.73%. Prior attempts in this family: 7. Hypothesis: the accepted local tie identifies a redundant hidden-unit vector, so share only that tied unit input/output vector across the two depth blocks while keeping each block’s 22 free hidden units and all output projections independent. This saves 14 parameters for a target of 2830. This is more informative than sharing a complete FF input/output projection, which failed at 7.83–10.19%, because it isolates the smallest cross-block dependency around the already validated tied unit; the nearest alternative is sharing a free hidden unit, which would change a nonlinear feature rather than the validated tied path. Keep d14/h2/L2, MQA, independent head-local maps, ff23 with one tied hidden unit per block, two final LayerNorm group scales, rank8 positions, affine-free block pre-norms, reversed operands, zero weight decay, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 2844 parameters.
